name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: HBD numeric +/- stepper: a native number input flanked by decrement (−) and increment (+) buttons, wrapped in the shared .hbd-field chrome (label + hint + error). Controlled-first value + onValueChange (string), min/max/step, sm/md/lg sizes, error/disabled states. Keyboard: the input is the sole Tab stop (buttons are tabIndex=-1); ArrowUp/Down = ±step, PageUp/Down = ±10·step, Home = min, End = max. Reuses @hbd/input's .hbd-field field chrome.
